name: mimg_generate_image
description: Generate one or more images from a text prompt and save them to the user's Metalcraft Images gallery. Requires `model` (an id from mimg_list_models whose `modes` include 'text-to-image') and `prompt`. Optional: `negative_prompt` (what to avoid), `num_images` (1-8, default 1 — EACH is billed), `image_size` (a preset string like 'square_hd', 'portrait_16_9', 'landscape_16_9', or an object {width,height}), `seed` (integer — reuse a previous image's seed to vary a prompt around the same composition), and `guidance_scale`. Returns the generation with a per-image `id`, a `url`, the per-image `seed`, and the `credits` charged. This SPENDS the user's real credits and needs a premium account — if the model, prompt, or count is ambiguous, confirm with the user before calling. If this call ever TIMES OUT, do NOT call it again: the generation is likely still running or already saved, so recover it with mimg_list_generations. Calling again double-charges.

model.description: Model id from mimg_list_models with 'text-to-image' in its modes.

num_images.description: How many images to generate (1-8, default 1). Each is billed.

image_size.description: A preset string ('square_hd', 'square', 'portrait_4_3', 'portrait_16_9', 'landscape_4_3', 'landscape_16_9') or an object {"width":N,"height":N}.

seed.description: Optional seed for reproducible/remixable results. Reuse a prior image's seed to vary a prompt around the same composition.
